summary_en: 122,241 shares to be cancelled (1.62% of pre-cancellation outstanding). Post-cancellation outstanding will be 7,427,759 shares. Effective 2026-10-20. Conditional on shareholder approval of stock consolidation (effective 2026-10-21) at extraordinary general meeting scheduled 2026-09-16.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: Tohoku Steel's board of directors resolved on 2026-07-30 to cancel 122,241 treasury shares held as of 2026-07-15, representing 1.62% of issued shares outstanding at that date. The cancellation is scheduled for 2026-10-20 and will reduce total issued shares from the current level to 7,427,759 post-cancellation. The cancellation is conditional upon shareholder approval of a separate stock consolidation proposal (effective 2026-10-21) to be voted at an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for 2026-09-16.
